remarks: **Brand New Heating & Central Air!** Why rent when you can own in Norwalk? Welcome to 14 1/2 Fairview Ave, Unit D4, located in the highly sought-after HighView Condo Complex in the heart of South Norwalk. This well-managed community offers low HOA fees in an unbeatable location, just steps away from the vibrant lifestyle of SoNo's best shopping, dining, and entertainment. (Not to mention a fantastic pool in the center of the courtyard!)  This bright and well-maintained condo features a spacious open floor plan, perfect for comfortable living and entertaining. The living and dining areas are flooded with natural light from large windows, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere with ample space for a dining table. The kitchen boasts plenty of cabinet and counter space, enhanced by fresh stylish cabinetry, making it ideal for those who love to cook.  Down the hall, you'll find a newly updated full bathroom with an elegant tiled shower and convenient stackable laundry. The generously sized bedroom includes three closets and a sliding glass door leading to your sunlit patio-a perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day.  The unit is in excellent condition and comes equipped with a brand-new heat/AC pump, less than a year old, ensuring comfort and efficiency year-round. Don't miss this opportunity to own a charming condo in one of Norwalk's best locations!
